stories.title: High tides prompt Flood Warning for parts of Solano County
stories.summary: A Flood Warning is in effect for low-lying areas along the San Pablo Bay, Carquinez Strait and Suisun Bay shorelines until 4 p.m. Thursday due to high tides.

stories.title: Sacramento Republic FC to hold USL championship parade in Sacramento Monday
stories.summary: Sacramento Republic FC will celebrate with a downtown parade Monday, Nov. 23, beginning at noon, with road closures starting 30 minutes earlier.

stories.title: Sacramento Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Weather is improving for Thanksgiving holiday travel across Northern California this week. Only minor impacts Tuesday and Wednesday.

stories.title: California cybersecurity startup identifies major software bug, prompting urgent calls for companies to install an update
stories.summary: A California company used AI to uncover a software bug in Java, one of the world’s most widely used programming language.

stories.title: Man killed, deputy injured in Antelope officer-involved shooting
stories.summary: Investigators say it started as a domestic dispute early Sunday morning.

stories.title: Cameron Park TikTok creator indicted on federal child exploitation charges
stories.summary: A 30-year-old Cameron Park man and TikTok creator faces federal charges of coercing a minor and distributing child sexual abuse material.

stories.title: Woman critically injured in e-bike crash in Roseville Saturday
stories.summary: A 30-year-old woman was critically injured in an e-bike crash Saturday in Roseville, according to police.

stories.title: Sacramento County deputy injured, suspect dead in Antelope shooting
stories.summary: A deputy and a suspect were taken to a hospital following a shooting Sunday morning in Antelope. The Sacramento County Sheriff's Office says the scene remains active

stories.title: Firefighters battle early morning fire at abandoned church in Sacramento
stories.summary: Firefighters responded to a fire at an abandoned church on Marconi Avenue in Sacramento early Sunday morning. The cause remains under investigation.

stories.title: 1 dead, 3 critically injured in Roseville Tesla crash involving DUI
stories.summary: One person died and three others were critically injured in a crash involving two Teslas in Roseville Saturday night. Police say DUI was a factor.

stories.title: Carmichael church, organizations team up to provide 500 Thanksgiving turkeys
stories.summary: Organizers say demand is high because of rising food prices.

stories.title: Sherman Island boating access to close due to king tides, potential storm surge
stories.summary: Sacramento County Regional Parks will close Sherman Island boating access starting due to anticipated king tides.
